appearanceDescription: Choose the theme and language used in this browser.

sharing.description: Create a time-limited access token for this project. Callers with the token can read generated documents when results:read is allowed; they cannot access raw CV uploads or private conversation history.
sharing.defaultOff: Sharing stays off until you create a token.
sharing.resultsPrivacy: Generated results may contain personal information. Grant only the capabilities needed.

sharingDefaultOff: Sharing stays off until you create a token.
sharingResultsPrivacy: Generated results may contain personal information. Grant only the capabilities needed.

capability.resultsRead: Read generated results (may contain personal information)
capability.jobsEvaluate: Evaluate job postings (AI evaluation and keyword fit check)
capability.documentsDraft: Draft application documents and follow-up messages
capability.cvTailor: Tailor your CV to a job (saved as a new CV document)
capability.applicationsApply: Prepare application answers from your CV and request that you approve a submission
capability.applicationsWrite: Move applications between stages and add notes on the board (never marks a job applied)

tokenWarning: This value is shown once. Copy it before closing or pressing Escape; the value cannot be recovered.

scope.appearance: This browser: theme and language apply only here.
scope.sharing: This project: tokens grant the selected permissions for this project only.
scope.webhooks: This project: webhooks belong to the selected project; Telegram is linked to your account.

telegramScope: Telegram connection and digest delivery are account-level settings.
